description: Returns a full-page PNG screenshot of a URL, captured in a real rendered browser (JavaScript executed). The response body is the image, not JSON. Cached for 24 hours per URL; X-Cached and X-Fetched-At response headers report cache status and fetch time. Costs $0.01 per call via x402.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to screenshot.

name: tariffmonkee-screenshot
